{{recipesummary|category=Confection recipes|time=10–12 minutes|difficulty=1}}

{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Confections|Confections]]

'''Chocolate balls''' are a quick, easy, and delightful snack that will give you your chocolate and peanut butter fix.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 11 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 g / 2.1 oz) puffed rice [[Cookbook:Breakfast Cereal|cereal]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:butter|melted butter]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (50 g / 1.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Nut|nuts]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:vanilla|vanilla]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (125 g / 4.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Icing Sugar|icing sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (125 g / 4.4 oz) fine [[Cookbook:coconut|coconut]]
* 1 small bag (50 g / 1.8 oz) semi-sweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]

==Procedure==
# Melt the semi-sweet chocolate chips in a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].
# Put all other ingredients into a bowl. Mix.  
# Form the mixture into small balls, about half the size of a golf ball.
# If desired, refrigerate or freeze the peanut butter balls for easier dipping.
# Dip the balls in the melted chocolate and place on wax paper.  
# Allow the chocolate balls to cool in the freezer or fridge before consumption.
